name: Weroz Pizza Kebab
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Weroz Pizza Kebab in Schwaz!**

Discover authentic flavors in the heart of Tirol. Whether you're craving a delicious **Pizza**, a juicy **Kebab**, or a hearty **Döner**, our menu has something for everyone.

Try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** for a sweet treat or enjoy a cold **Radler** on the terrace. Come by and experience the best of local and international cuisine in Schwaz!

**Weroz – Good food, great vibes!**
